info.title: lite-deploy agent API
info.description: The API of the agent on the server. It listens on the unix socket /run/lite-deploy/api.sock (nothing is opened to the network); the caller is identified by the kernel (SO_PEERCRED) and must be a system administrator (group sudo or wheel). lite-ui reaches it through ssh with `lite-deploy call-stream`. Requests that change the server carry an X-Lite-Sig header once an owner key is registered. More than the configured number of changing requests per hour is refused (quota_exceeded).

ownerSignature.name: X-Lite-Sig
ownerSignature.description: v1.KEYID.TIMESTAMP.NONCE.SIGNATURE (ed25519 over the method, path, body hash, server id, time and a one-time number).
